an1.198:1.1: The story of how he overcame rejection, was supported by the Buddha, and achieved mastery is given in his verses at [thag10.4](). The younger brother of Mahāpanthaka, he is praised at [ud5.10](), and give effective instruction to the nuns at [pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.1]().
an1.199:1.1: The “evolution of consciousness” (_cetovivaṭṭa_) and the “evolution of perception” (_saññāvivaṭṭa_) are said in the late canon to be the same thing ([ps1.1:503.1]()).
